item.title: Jamaat's Latifur vows support for entrants from AL, BNP
item.description: Jamaat-e-Islami central Majlis-e-Shura member and former Chapainawab-ganj-3 lawmaker, Professor Latifur Rahman, has assured that individuals joining the party will not face harassment from courts, police stations, or other law enforcement agencies. He added that the party would take responsibility for those joining from the Awami League or BNP.He made the remarks during a courtyard meeting at Fatapara Madan Mor in Charbagdanga Union, Sadar upazila, on Tuesday afternoon (December 30). item.title: Fuel oil prices cut by Tk 2 per litre

item.title: Nation observing last day of 3-day state mourning over death of Begum Khaleda Zia

item.title: Ferry services resume on Paturia–Daulatdia route after 7-hour suspension
item.description: Ferry operations on the Paturia–Daulatdia river route resumed at around 10am on Friday after remaining suspended for seven hours due to dense fog.Two ferries anchored mid-river during the suspension safely reached the terminals as visibility improved, allowing stranded vehicles to begin crossing the river, reports UNB.BIWTC Aricha sector Deputy General Manager Abdus Salam said ferry movement on the Paturia–Daulatdia and Aricha–Kazirhat routes was halted from 3am because of poor visibility.At the

item.title: Housewife's hanging body recovered in capital's Hazaribagh
item.description: Police recovered the hanging body of a housewife from a residence in Dhanmondi-15 Staff Quarters area under Hazaribagh Police Station in the capital on Thursday evening.The deceased was identified as Taharim, 20, daughter of Md Hafiz Uddin of Dirakati area under Jhalakathi Sadar upazila. item.title: Bangladesh welcomes China's stance on election

item.title: 6 killed in Iran protests over economic woes
item.description: Protests over Iran’s deepening economic woes turned deadly, with at least six people killed in clashes between demonstrators and security forces in western parts of the country, marking the first reported deaths since demonstrations began earlier this week, reports TRT World.The demonstrations erupted on Sunday in Tehran, where shopkeepers launched strikes to protest soaring prices and prolonged economic stagnation.
